parameters.name: ClassifyId
parameters.description: The software classification ID. You can call [ListSoftwarelibClassify](~~ListSoftwarelibClassify~~) to obtain the value.

parameters.name: CurrentPage
parameters.description: The page number of the current page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 10000.

parameters.name: MaxResults
parameters.description: The maximum number of entries per page. This parameter is not supported by this operation. Use CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination.

parameters.name: NextToken
parameters.description: The pagination token. This parameter is not supported by this operation. Use CurrentPage and PageSize for pagination.

parameters.name: Os
parameters.description:
The operating system to which the software package applies. Valid values:
- **Windows**: Windows.
- **Mac(Apple)**: macOS with Apple silicon.
- **Mac(Intel)**: macOS with Intel processors.

parameters.name: PageSize
parameters.description: The number of entries per page in a paging query. Valid values: 1 to 500.

parameters.name: SoftwareName
parameters.description: The software name. Fuzzy match is supported.

parameters.name: SourceType
parameters.description:
The software source. Valid values:
- **custom**: custom software.
- **builtin**: built-in software library.
